overview: India MedTech Expo & Investment Support is a platform designed to showcase innovations in the medical technology sector, connect stakeholders, and promote investment opportunities in MedTech. The event facilitates networking between startups, investors, industry players, and government bodies to accelerate the growth of the MedTech ecosystem in India. It aims to highlight cutting-edge technologies, foster collaborations, and support the scaling of MedTech ventures through exposure and matchmaking.
objectives: Showcase innovations and advancements in the medical technology sector
Facilitate networking and collaboration between startups, investors, and industry stakeholders
Promote investment opportunities in the MedTech ecosystem
Support the growth and scaling of MedTech startups and MSMEs
Highlight government initiatives and policies supporting healthcare innovation
eligibility: Open to MedTech startups, MSMEs, innovators, and companies involved in healthcare technology, medical devices, diagnostics, and digital health solutions seeking to showcase their products or explore investment opportunities.
benefits: Opportunity to exhibit products and innovations at a national-level expo, access to potential investors and venture capitalists, networking with industry experts and healthcare institutions, visibility among policymakers and government officials, and support for business development and market access.
financial_support: The scheme does not provide direct financial grants or subsidies; support is primarily through investment matchmaking, exhibition opportunities, and facilitation of funding connections rather than direct monetary assistance.
application_process: 1. Visit the official India MedTech Expo website or portal. 2. Register as an exhibitor, startup, or visitor based on your profile. 3. Submit company profile, product details, and innovation summary. 4. Await confirmation of participation from the organizing committee. 5. Prepare exhibit materials and attend the expo for showcasing and networking.
required_documents: Details of funding or investment sought (if applicable)
deadlines: Based on event schedule; specific dates announced annually for each edition of the expo.
implementing_agency: Department of Pharmaceuticals, Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers
caveats: Participation is subject to selection and approval by the organizing committee
Exhibition space and slots are limited and allocated on a first-come, first-served or merit basis
The expo is conducted periodically; opportunities are tied to specific event dates
No guarantee of funding or investment outcomes from participation
